// Source of the `layout diff` fixture pair. Not compiled by anything in the
// repository — it exists so the two committed snapshots can be regenerated.
// See scripts/test/fixtures/layout-diff-pair/README.md.
package com.demcha.compose.document.fixtures.layoutdiff;

import com.demcha.compose.document.api.DocumentSession;
import com.demcha.compose.document.dsl.SectionBuilder;

public final class LayoutDiffFixtureDocument {

    /** The single property the pair differs by. BEFORE = 0, AFTER = 12. */
    private static final float PANEL_PADDING_LEFT = 0f;   // BEFORE; the AFTER snapshot was rendered with 12f

    public void compose(DocumentSession document) {
        document.pageFlow(page -> page
                .name("LayoutDiffFixture")
                .spacing(8)
                .addSection("Panel", LayoutDiffFixtureDocument::renderPanel)
                .addSection("Untouched", LayoutDiffFixtureDocument::renderUntouched));
    }

    /** The section whose padding moves. Three children, so the diff has descendants to name. */
    private static void renderPanel(SectionBuilder section) {
        section.spacing(4)
                .padding(0, 0, 0, PANEL_PADDING_LEFT)
                .addParagraph("Invoice number")
                .addParagraph("Issue date")
                .addParagraph("Amount due");
    }

    /** The sibling that must not move. A padding.left change above cannot reach it. */
    private static void renderUntouched(SectionBuilder section) {
        section.spacing(4)
                .addParagraph("Terms")
                .addParagraph("Net 30");
    }
}
